note: Port map v1 of the product engine (plan file 29 §2.3, package C0c): the pure families of §1.2 that the first Rust packages (C2, C3) port, and the event reducer. Every family takes every function export of its module as an entry (allExports): export lists are read from the modules when they load, never written here. Everything a family imports and this map does not name is inlined: part of the unit, implemented inside the same Rust module. Ports sit only where another family's state is read or written (the abort guard and the committed revert resends, both module state owned by time-driven or action families) and where the caller hands the reducer functions (its callbacks). No port is waived as unordered: every effect order is compared.

families.name: reducer
families.note: The directory and global event reducer (design §1.2, §1.3; C3). applyDirectoryEvent mutates its draft (arg 0): the change set is recorded. Inlined: binary search, sessionDiffStats, nativeCursorText, session-cache, sanitize, part-delta, session-user-activity, revert-transactions' state queries, toolStatus, sessionTitles, session-recency, display-session (zod), message-order, and debug (its flag is a module-cached platform read, see the C0c report). The module-level WeakMap sessionSummaryMemo is an optimisation keyed by array identity: not state the census asks for, but it can return a cached Session object, so identity in results depends on it within a file (C0c report).
